biblicalcontent/get

Retrieve index information about the content of manuscript page: each page's verse range, with its letter offsets (how much of its first verse lies before the page and of its last verse after it, in letters of the base text), who indexed it and at what tier (4 and up: an AI's indexing a person has still to confirm), and, with baseText, the letters on the page.

Parameters

NameRequiredDefaultDescriptionExample
docIDtrueN/Amanuscript id to query10046
pageIDfalsepage id to query10
detailfalseshortwhether to use a (short) range format for verses or break them up into individual entries (long)long
baseTextfalsea base text to count each page's letters in (short detail only): an NTVMR docID (e.g. 1002800 = NA28NS) or a crosswire.org module (e.g. CrossWire:Byz?toNomSacs=true), as the project's transcriptionBaseDefault spells it. Adds letters to each page: the letters of its verses less the two offsets, the count the indexing guess rests on. The first call for a crosswire module fetches its books (a few seconds a book)1002800
baseTextUserNamefalsewith a docID baseText, whose transcription of it: a user or project name; omit for the published onejsmith
formatfalsespecified at session openresponse output format (json|xml|csv|gchart)json

Errors

{docID} may not be null-4
